payload.text: hv, 2026-10-17 20:25Z: rhad moves onto devbin's Homebrew install. Its machine pointer (~/.local/share/devbin/home, naming the checkout install ~/Devel/opt/devbin at 0.1.11) is removed, with a copy kept in dc's scratch, so fleet distributes from $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/devbin/libexec (0197) and every estate records that path. ~/Devel/opt/devbin stays on disk, stale and unused. hv chose option (1), as vc and dc recommended, so the 0.1.12 sweep could run; it is not put to hv again.
